presentation: Chaptered implementation/evidence guide, not continuous live screen recording
voice: Windows System.Speech synthetic narration; no person impersonated

scenes.title: Problem: useful warning before disruption
scenes.narration: We are RASCALS from Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science. ContinuityGuard helps operators detect developing faults behind essential digital services. It connects telemetry, warning evidence and an inspectable response preview. Hospital software defines our demonstration priorities; no patient data is used.

scenes.title: Actual AI fitting and selection on LinuxONE
scenes.narration: Native s390x Jupyter fitted five candidates with separate training, calibration and validation. Calibrated logistic regression was selected for repeat triage. Initial threshold warnings are preserved. Observed breach limits bypass filtering. Independent forecast paging is disabled; Isolation Forest adds novelty context.

scenes.title: Follow a real inference path on controlled data
scenes.narration: This frozen-model timeline uses a declared synthetic database-pressure scenario. Persistent signals create incidents with retained measurements, dependent services and a reviewed runbook. Bounded episode rechecks fix the old permanent-alert suppression. Published scenario outputs retain notification event times.

scenes.title: Local explanation and the response tradeoff
scenes.narration: Granite generates constrained wording locally with verified evidence IDs. This paired simulator example models 309 additional successful urgent-results transactions, while deferring 1175 optional requests. Both paths use identical demand. No real service is remediated.

scenes.title: The measured comparison, including misses
scenes.narration: On 180 fresh synthetic runs, both methods warned early for 130 of 135 incidents. Precision improved from 43.5 to 45.3 percent. Unmatched notifications fell from 174 to 162. Both retained 11-second median early lead and 1 miss. This is a modest within-simulator improvement.

scenes.title: Verify native execution and the failure boundaries
scenes.narration: 43 native tests passed, including warning preservation, repeat filtering, causal features, malformed inputs and failures. The authenticated local HTTP path processed one thousand offered events in ten seconds. Published evidence verifies model hashes, container restrictions, local generation and restart persistence. Queue acknowledgement differs from completed inference.

scenes.title: Original data and learnings from the datathon
scenes.narration: A separate notebook records sixty-four actual LinuxONE service observations with a raw CSV and provenance hash. These do not validate the simulator predictor. We learned to preserve baselines, freeze before testing and retain rejected experiments. Toolkit acceleration remains unverified without entitlement.

scenes.title: A reproducible handoff
scenes.narration: The public repository contains source, six executed notebooks, results and deployment instructions. The team reviews the work, confirms prerequisite mapping and submits manually. ContinuityGuard makes warning evidence and notification tradeoffs inspectable. This chaptered walkthrough uses disclosed synthetic narration.
